BoxName.about: The box's name and whether it is answering.

Applying.about: While the box applies a change: how far it got, and a game to play meanwhile. Shows nothing otherwise.

Apps.about: The apps on this box as tiles, with the storage strip under them.

Glance.about: The widgets: the ones LosOS has and the ones written by hand.

Disk.about: How full the disk is, and the reserve the box can add to it.

Name.about: The box's name and the address it is reached at on this network.

Reaching.about: Whether the box can be reached from outside this network.

Windows.about: Whether the box shows up under Network in File Explorer. Shows nothing on a box without it.

Hidden.about: The Tor and I2P addresses. Shows nothing on a box without them.

Graphics.about: The switch for the graphics chip.

Protections.about: The extra protections, each with what it costs, and the note on a box without a TPM.

Counts.about: What was counted on the apps' ports, as charts.

ThisBox.about: The box's name, its addresses and how its storage is used.

Tour.about: The link that shows the tour again.

SpareTime.about: Whether the box is on a mesh and when it lends its time.

Updates.about: When the box updates and restarts.

StartOver.about: The button that resets the settings, and its confirmation.

Erase.about: Erasing the box, with a backup first.

NotLoaded.about: Why the look did not load. Shows nothing once it has.

Edge.about: The edges in reach and the one this box uses.

Cluster.about: The mesh this box is in.

LocalShare.about: Sharing with the gateways of this network only.

Manage.about: Who may manage this box from the edge.

Join.about: The switch that joins the mesh.

SpareTime.about: When the box lends its processor to the mesh.

Sharing.about: The switch that shares the disk with the mesh.

Lend.about: Lending this box to AI models on the mesh.

Status.about: While the market loads, or when it cannot be reached: why. Shows nothing once it has answered.

AiModels.about: AI models paid for in USDC. Shows nothing on an edge without them.

Sell.about: What this box offers for sale.

Earnings.about: What this box has earned. Shows nothing before it has.

Status.about: While the machines load, or when they are not offered: why. Shows nothing once they have.

Mine.about: The machines this box runs on the mesh.

Images.about: The disk images to start machines from.

Host.about: The machines this box hosts for others.

Sites.about: LosOS Cloud's and LosOS Git's settings, each folded.

Yours.about: The apps built on this box.

Box.about: The apps installed on this box, and finding more.

Status.about: While the pane loads, or when it cannot: why. Shows nothing once it has.

Seal.about: What the box's secrets are sealed to.

Apps.about: The secrets of each app, and making new ones.

Status.about: While the pane loads, or when it cannot: why. Shows nothing once it has.

HostKey.about: The box's own key, to check it by.

Keys.about: The keys that may sign calls to this box.

Tokens.about: The access tokens made so far.

Status.about: While the pane loads, or when it cannot: why. Shows nothing once it has.

Held.about: Why the account is held, while it is. Shows nothing otherwise.

Profile.about: The name and the picture others see.

Contact.about: The account's details, such as its email address.

Factors.about: The second steps of signing in.

Pictures.about: The pictures kept for the account.

Windows.about: Signing in to the files from Windows.

Status.about: While the pane loads, or when it cannot: why. Shows nothing once it has.

People.about: The people who use this box.

CustomRoles.about: The roles made on this box. Shows nothing where there are none.

Rules.about: The rules for new people. Shows nothing where there are none.

Status.about: While the pane loads, or when it cannot: why. Shows nothing once it has.

Log.about: What was done, and by whom.

Search.about: The search over every option, and how many there are.

Nothing.about: What a search that finds nothing says.

Options.about: Every option, by group, and the question before a dangerous change.

Strays.about: Lines in the settings file that no option names. Shows nothing where there are none.

About.about: Where the options are kept and what is left out.

Repository.about: The Git repository the settings are kept in.

Clone.about: How to clone it, and syncing now. Shows nothing without a repository.

Update.about: Where the box takes its updates from.

Waiting.about: While a change is applied: that backups wait for it. Shows nothing otherwise.

Code.about: The recovery code the backups are encrypted with.

Backups.about: The backups made so far, and making one now.

Status.about: Loading, and what shows when the problems cannot be read.

Reporting.about: Whether reports can be sent, and where they go.

Report.about: The report you read before you send it.

Filters.about: The service, level, time and text to show.

Notices.about: What went wrong while reading or downloading.

Hidden.about: The note on what is hidden.
